proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived a residual support criterion, exact weighted frontier, and a bounded-pathwidth hardness construction. After adding the missing eligibility premise and repairing the closest-result comparisons, the final D0.5 math panel passed with no findings and the cited-source check passed. The field novelty gate still rated the package incremental because exact symbolic tie compression, useful-scale implementation, and comparative evidence remain open; one peripheral related-work finding remained in the decision panel.
tldr: Assuming the observed own edges satisfy \(M\subseteq E\), the standard alternating/residual argument, specialized to the declared rational full additive objective, characterizes exact deterministic-output support by absence of an augmented negative cycle, including paths to unused controls. This is not presented as a new general optimum-matching criterion. A matching-specific canonical min-plus frontier then computes exact rational masses and backward samples with explicit width and distance-range dependence; existing exact weighted projected counting and generic treewidth results are acknowledged. The parsimonious hardness result is confined to its displayed preserving-orientation family with binary general costs and one unused control, and the tie-ring result concerns only literal equality-keyed full-objective distance matrices. Symbolic tie compression remains open.
gap: Published match-adaptive inference exploits absolute differences on one ordered score, while assignment duality treats a fixed bipartite graph and generic projected counters treat arbitrary Boolean encodings. None of the checked results characterizes the treatment orientations that reproduce one selected general-cost pair match with unused controls and an explicit additive tie rule.
fill: The augmented residual graph supplies an if-and-only-if support theorem, with a complete non-scalar certificate establishing strict containment; its canonical live-bag distances supply exact mass and sampling. The conditional and lattice laws follow from those kernels, while matching-specific hardness plus the literal tie obstruction state precisely which parameter dependencies remain unavoidable for the proved representation.
